name: BREAK OUT OF YOUR SHELL
source:
You play out the story of two students.

Takara, a seasoned Magical Girl who quit out of dissatisfaction.

And Hitomi, a troubled soul who wants to please everyone. 

A story about Magical Girls that transcend past their armor into something completely their own. 

[From [url=https://noma-bp.itch.io/break-out-of-your-shell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你讲述了两个学生的故事。

宝，一位经验丰富的魔法少女，因不满而退出。

还有瞳，一个充满烦恼的灵魂，想要取悦所有人。

这是一个关于魔法少女超越她们的盔甲，成为完全属于她们自己的东西的故事。

[来自[url=https://noma-bp.itch.io/break-out-of-your-shell]itch.io[/url]]
